name: weekly_summary
description: Weekly assignment hours for the cohort, the weekly limit, hidden tasks found in briefs, issues, and how many crunch weeks exist at other limits.

name: list_allowed_moves
description: The deadline moves the rules allow right now (1-2 weeks later, never earlier, never fixed tests, never festive or revision weeks). Only these can be proposed.

name: request_approval
description: Send ONE allowed move (an index from list_allowed_moves) to the programme leader for approval. Nothing changes until that person approves via a single-use, expiring link.

name: check_draft_assignment
description: Before a lecturer publishes a deadline: would it push a week over the limit, and which nearby weeks are lightest?
